1 One hue: sage on a warm near-black ground. The only
other ink in the run is #eebf09, the store card band.
2 Every corner is a right angle. No radius, no chamfer,
no notch and no tab in any of the four traces.
3 Selection is a solid sage fill with dark ink: nav SMG,
list row 1, tile BRAINDANCE, badge T2, REPORT SPAM,
NEXT, and card 1 down through its values row.
4 One stroke weight: the 1.25px bright core measured at
3840 (2px as designed, as mailbox-trace draws it).
There is no second, dimmer outline tone in the photo.
5 Fills sit 1px inside their frame (list row x 85..451
in a frame at x 84..451); nav rows are flush instead.
6 Text is inset 12px from its frame edge: header string
at x 61 in a strip at x 49; card title at x+12.
7 Cells are joined by dividers, never spaced by gaps:
nav pitch 61, list 62, buttons ~187, tile rows 273.
8 Section headers are a 26x26 boxed letter + a label;
on the store they sit BELOW what they label.
9 Micro-print everywhere, 7.5 to 9.5px: under cards and
tiles, under MAIL BOX, under the store nav.
Trace against src/eras/entropism.rs and the era README.
Listed, not fixed: nothing under src/ was edited.
· metrics.stroke = 1.0, and both the module doc comment
and the README say "1px strokes". Every trace measures
1.25px at full resolution, and the mailbox draws 2px;
the README's own rules list also says 2px. The screen
arms already pass 2.0 / 1.25 explicitly, so the metric
only reaches a widget that inherits it.
· The palette consts run dimmer than every trace:
· OUTLINE #5d7752 matches nothing measured. The k-means
1600 rescale's dilution of the bright core, and
#5d7752 is dimmer still; mailbox() strokes its frames
· BG #110c07 with Ground::Flat; all four traces ground
· Layout::TileRow draws one row of four tiles where
dashboard-trace measures a 3x2 grid of six, with a
detail panel and a badge column beside it.
